title: GS21 leverage hump, continuous firm-level coupon, gs_bv -0.5, bounded exposure, PER-FIRM level compensation (gs_qcomp 1), gamma_v 4.0
question: With the priced value of the y factor equalised across firms, does the leverage hump survive into the observed leverage characteristic (coupon over market equity) and clear the bar?
notes:
WHY (2026-11-04). gvylqm5/10 had room 2-8% although the equity y-slope is a strong hump in the coupon (0 at the edges, +0.34 at mid coupon in sol_gvylqm10a). The exposed mid-coupon firms are priced at 7-9 against 110-190 at the edges, so their lev = b / P is the highest in the panel and the premium is MONOTONE in observed leverage, which the linear model spans. gs_qcomp 1 (gs_solve_vy.py) scales each firm's production by W(e)^-1, W(e) the priced mean of its own y factor, so the y exposure no longer moves the equity price and lev tracks the coupon; the hump is then in the observed characteristic.

PRECOMMITMENT STATUS: precommitted=false; ids filled from the Quest build log by the solve script before any seed runs.

PREDICTION (2026-11-04): the premium across lev quintiles is hump-shaped; room 30% or more and a fair gap at or above +0.029. FALSIFIED if room is at or below 10% on three seeds.

method.gs_vy_exposure: production x exp(gs_bv (gs_bzl + gs_bzi z~) y)
method.gs_vy_sign_ladder: one type; exposure gs_bv (b~^2 - 1) on the continuous firm coupon
method.gs_capital_structure: gs_fixcs 2: firm-level coupon per unit capital drawn at birth uniformly from the grid nodes in [0.1, 0.9], fixed for life, no refinancing

seeds.policy: run_oracle.py --seed drives BOTH the firm-level shocks and the aggregate y path (reg_seed offset by the seed).
